nodes.question: What types of materials are recommended for reducing energy consumption in residential buildings in the Sichuan Plateau?
nodes.answer: High-efficiency thermal insulation materials are recommended for reducing energy consumption in residential buildings on the Sichuan Plateau.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Eco-friendly construction materials|Energy-efficient insulation materials_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the significance of the findings in this paper regarding global temperature changes?
nodes.answer: The findings show that cotton and hemp fibre insulation have a negligible impact on global temperature changes, achieving a net-zero effect in the short term and close-to-zero impact in the long term.
